sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to face Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong this season with seven wins from their last six games showing their overall consistency. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five outings, making this a favorable fixture for the league leaders.
divisionWide: The title race remains competitive with several teams in close contention. Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home—notably, Wednesfield will then play at Brereton Social on Wednesday 7 October in a midweek fixture. In-form Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) visit Foley Meir, while Barnton host Shawbury United; Shawbury are in dire form with six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle of struggling sides near the bottom. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes have picked up just 2 points all season with five defeats in their last six. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a lower-mid-table fixture.
